Manchester United v Bournemouth (Kick-off 2.00pm). Commentary on the top-flight match at Old Trafford. Both clashes between these teams last season ended in draws, including a 4-4 see-saw stalemate here in December that saw United take the lead three times and the Cherries hold the lead once themselves.
